summary: Enhance your skills in managing non-performing loans with our comprehensive course. Learn strategies to improve recovery and boost financial performance.
lede: Non-performing loan management covers how credit and recovery professionals identify, monitor and resolve distressed loans. It is for credit risk managers, recovery officers and analysts who assess loan portfolios and plan resolution strategies. The course covers loan classification, early warning indicators, restructuring options and collateral valuation, with practice in portfolio sales and recovery reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for maintaining asset quality and institutional solvency in the financial services sector.
modules: Credit Risk Monitoring and Early Warning
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of credit risk and basic financial accounting. Familiarity with Excel for financial modeling is recommended as the course involves impairment calculations. No prior experience in legal insolvency is required.
